ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~8%) to low-intensity pixels (~92%); primary fluke surface is near-black with highly localized, high-intensity white/cream clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base across the entire visible surface; no large-scale white mottling; discrete high-contrast circular blobs (barnacles/scars) distributed randomly across both lobes with higher density at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 55 degrees; apex is distinct and vertically aligned with the caudal peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of valleys varies significantly (3-10 pixels deep); contour is heavily distorted by biological protrusions (barnacle clusters) on distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve on the leading edges and distal margins; trailing edges exhibit a slight sigmoid curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; highest concentration of circular white scars (~10-20 pixels in diameter) on the distal margins and lower central areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear white marks (rake-like scratches) visible on the right lobe, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive, bulbous colonies of barnacles concentrated on the extreme left and right distal tips, significantly altering the natural geometric silhouette of the fluke; multiple circular ring-scars from prior barnacle attachments visible on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-on-dark texture variations suggesting water runoff or slight physical depressions in the fluke tissue near the median notch.
